comparison.objective: Candidate commissions a robot-axis shock absorber; record plugs a USB stick into a computer.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires hex-key insertion followed by torque-controlled rotary tuning and testing; record requires connector pose alignment and insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe dynamic stops and locked-setting retention. Board record omits setup, scoring, insertion-depth or electrical-recognition criteria, damage limits, and run limit.
comparison.reason: Connector insertion and damper calibration test different mechanisms and outcomes; insertion alone does not cover iterative dynamic tuning.
